name: DOOMFLY
description: The neurons of the public DOOMFLY demo (github.com/nftechie/doomfly, MIT): the turn is DNp20 right minus left, the walk and the fire are DNpe017. They are not the biology of walking and turning (the authors say so); they are the neurons that answer to the picture in this model: the descending neurons of the biological set (controls_bio.json) stay silent. The gains and the thresholds are ours.
